reasoning_traces.think:
The core tension lies in the duality of GSE’s identity: it must maintain both a transparent, calibrated forecasting system and a sustainable business model that includes affiliate revenue. The calibrated edge gate enforces a strict operational discipline—stake only when both edge and confidence exceed thresholds. This prevents overconfidence-driven losses but also risks suppressing valid opportunities. Straddling occurs when marketing continues to assert 'no affiliate' while operations enable such flows, creating a contradiction that undermines trust. The transparency ceiling asserts that value is not dependent on beating markets but on honest presentation of data. Thus, any deviation from this principle—whether in code or marketing—is a failure mode that erodes long-term viability. The system must therefore enforce consistency across layers: from algorithmic gatekeeping to strategic communication.
